AutoPopulate.NoTypes: No item types available to populate

Rest.Hint: Take a rest (restores HP, spell slots and daily abilities)
Rest.Label: Rest

Settings.AutoPopulatePCsHint: Off by default so players keep their own layout.
Settings.ShowHealthOverlayHint: Colour-coded health bar at the bottom of the portrait. Click it to change HP.
Settings.ShowItemNamesHint: Draw the item name under each hotbar cell.
Settings.TintTokenByHealthHint: Also tint the tokens on the map: yellow below 75%, orange-red below 50%, dark red below 25%, grey when down, purple when staggered by nonlethal damage. Writes texture.tint and restores it when healed. Off by default.
Settings.ShowCasterLevel: Show caster level (CL) in item tooltips
Settings.AutoPopulatePassivesHint: Put permanent buffs and action-less feats on the passive bar under the portrait.
Settings.AutoPopulateEnabledHint: Fill the hotbar from the actor's items when a token is created.
Settings.ShowCasterLevelHint: When hovering an item, show its caster level (system.cl) at the right of the tooltip header. Works for any item that has a CL: scrolls, potions, wands, weapons, armor. Off by default.
Settings.DamageOverlayHint: Red rises from the bottom of the portrait as you take damage; hidden at full health.
Settings.ShowItemUsesHint: Display remaining uses for potions, wands and daily abilities.
Settings.IgnoreGroupActorsHint: Do not show the HUD for party/group actors.
Settings.ConfigureGridsHint: Choose which item types land in grid 0 / 1 / 2.
Settings.ShowSpellInfo: Show spell level and save DC on consumables
Settings.ShowSpellInfoHint: When hovering a scroll, potion or wand, show 'level N' and 'DC N' badges next to the item name. Reads the action's save.dc formula; falls back to 10 + level + min casting ability modifier. Enabled by default.
Settings.ShowPassivesHint: The row of small icons above the portrait (class features, feats, traits, …). Turn it off to hide the whole bar. Re-select the token or reload after changing.
Settings.PassiveFilterHint: "All traits" shows every passive; "Only with uses" keeps just items that have a Uses pool (daily class abilities, potions, wands…), hiding purely passive feats and always-on buffs.
